# 🔶 P9.1 — Grace Idempotence

**Mode:** `FW_EXTENDED` | **Atlas Type:** `Property` | **Status:** `property`
**Domain:** Moral | **Legacy ID:** `AX-076`

## Statement

Grace applied twice = grace applied once. Redundant grace doesn't accumulate.

## Formal Expression

```
Ĝ² = Ĝ (idempotent)
```

$$
Ĝ² = Ĝ (idempotent)
$$
